messages.subject: Space-time interpolation/fill gaps using r-inla?
parts:
Hi guys,

 Is there any published papers that used r-inla in space-time interpolation for gap filling based on adjacent pixels (space and time)?

I know that Cameletti et al. (2012) did some work on interpolation, but it was based on several covariates. In my case, I want to fill gaps of Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) pixels/grid based on adjacent pixels (its either closest in space or time). I am working with satellite imageries.

Anybody willing to help in pointing me some direction?
